naslov.en: The list of the fifth class.

lede.sr: Rad na prototipovima se nastavlja. Na spisku stoji 29 imenovanih zapisa i 30. zapis za rad sa kadrova 82–84 čiji autor nije upisan; objavljeno je svih 29 fotografisanih radova sa ukupno 86 fotografija u učionici i 10 fotografija sa posete udruženju. Ispod spiska su otvorena pitanja — studenti neka se jave za potvrdu autorstva, naziva i rasporeda.
lede.en: The prototype work continues. The list carries 29 named entries plus a 30th entry for the work in frames 82–84 whose author was not written down; all 29 photographed works are published with 86 classroom photographs and 10 photographs from the association visit. Open questions stand below the list — students, please get in touch to confirm authorship, titles and sequence.

description.sr: Nastavnikov spisak petog časa (30.10.2026), zapisivan redom vođenja; broj uz zapis je broj fotografija. Fotografije: telefon nastavnika, 11:44–14:08. Nastavnik je naveo da na kraju spiska verovatno nedostaje jedan zapis.
description.en: The teacher’s list of the fifth class (30 October 2026), recorded in the order it was kept; the number beside an entry is its photograph count. Photographs: the teacher’s phone, 11:44–14:08. The teacher noted that one entry is probably missing near the end of the list.

napomena.sr: Brojevi su brojevi fotografija, ne ocene. Zapisi bez objavljenih fotografija stoje niže, u delu „Šta se čeka”.
napomena.en: The numbers count photographs, not grades. Entries without published photographs stand below, in the „What we wait for” part.

presek.sr: Svih 90 kadrova sa telefona nastavnika je raspoređeno i objavljeno: kadrovi 1–81 prate redosled imenovanih zapisa 1–27, kadrovi 82–84 objavljeni su kao zapis 30 (tabla 4×4 i kartice sa parovima obojenih tačaka, čiji se autor traži), kadrovi 85–88 objavljeni su u prilogu posete udruženju (zajedno sa 6 studentskih fotografija sa Drive-a, ukupno 10 kadrova posete), a kadrovi 89 i 90 pripadaju zapisima 28 i 29 snimljenim posle posete.
presek.en: All 90 frames from the teacher’s phone have been assigned and published: frames 1–81 follow the order of named entries 1–27, frames 82–84 are published as entry 30 (the 4×4 board and tiles with pairs of coloured dots, awaiting author confirmation), frames 85–88 are published in the association visit attachment (together with the 6 student Drive photographs, 10 visit frames in all), and frames 89 and 90 belong to entries 28 and 29 taken after the visit.

analizaUdruzenja.sr: Spisak beleži četiri fotografije iz udruženja na telefonu nastavnika (kadrovi 85–88). Sve četiri su objavljene u dosijeu posete petog časa zajedno sa šest studentskih fotografija sa Drive-a (ukupno deset kadrova, sedam prepoznatih radova).
analizaUdruzenja.en: The list records four association photographs on the teacher’s phone (frames 85–88). All four are published in the fifth-class visit dossier together with the six student photographs from Drive (ten frames in all, seven recognised works).

napomena.sr: rad fotografisan u učionici (kadrovi 82–84) i isproban u udruženju (kadar 6 posete); ime autora nije upisano na spisku časa.
napomena.en: work photographed in the classroom (frames 82–84) and tried at the association (visit frame 6); the author’s name was not entered on the class list.

sta.sr: Zapis 30 (kadrovi 82–84, bela tabla 4×4 sa parovima obojenih tačaka spojenih linijama i šesnaest kvadratnih kartica za poklapanje): rad je fotografisan u učionici odmah posle zapisa 27 i istog dana isproban u udruženju (šesti kadar posete), ali za njega nema upisanog imena na spisku časa. Rad je objavljen; molimo autora da se javi kako bismo povezali dosije i upisali naziv.
sta.en: Entry 30 (frames 82–84, a white 4×4 board with pairs of coloured dots joined by lines and sixteen square matching tiles): the work was photographed in the classroom right after entry 27 and tried the same day at the association (visit frame 6), but no author name was written for it on the class list. The work is published; its author is asked to get in touch so we can link the dossier and record the title.

sta.sr: Zapisi 25, 26 i 27 (kadrovi 74–81) i zapis 30 (kadrovi 82–84): između zapisa 24 i grupnih snimaka u udruženju fotografisana su četiri rada sa 2, 3, 3 i 3 kadra (74–75 kartonska maketa prostorije sa ogledalom i plavim valjkom; 76–78 tri povezana obruča u boji i kuglice od srebrne folije; 79–81 drveni ram sa kanapima i svetlucavim oblicima; 82–84 tabla 4×4 sa karticama sa tačkama), dok na spisku stoje tri imena sa brojevima 2, 3 i 3. Raspored 25–27 sledi redosled spiska, a četvrti niz (82–84) izdvojen je kao zapis 30; ako je izostavljeno ime zapravo bilo ranije u tom nizu (između zapisa 25 i 27), molimo autor(k)e ovih radova da jave tačno poklapanje. Takođe, uz zapis 26 prenet je raniji naziv sa četvrtog časa („igra sa užetom”), dok fotografije prikazuju nov predmet sa obručima i kuglicama od folije.
sta.en: Entries 25, 26 and 27 (frames 74–81) and entry 30 (frames 82–84): between entry 24 and the association shots, four works were photographed with 2, 3, 3 and 3 frames (74–75 a cardboard room model with a mirror and blue cylinder; 76–78 three linked coloured rings and silver foil balls; 79–81 a wooden frame with cords and glittery shapes; 82–84 the 4×4 dot-card board), whereas the list carries three names with counts 2, 3 and 3. Rows 25–27 follow the list order and the fourth sequence (82–84) is published as entry 30; if the omitted name actually stood earlier in that stretch (between entries 25 and 27), the authors of these works are asked to confirm the exact match. Also, entry 26 inherited its fourth-class title (“igra sa užetom”) while the photographs show a new object with rings and foil balls.

sta.sr: Zapisi 13, 14, 16, 17, 20 i 24: na rukopisnom spisku petog časa nisu bili upisani nazivi radova, pa su pri prvoj obradi preneti nazivi iz ranijih nedelja istih autora. Pregledom fotografija utvrđeno je da nekoliko radova prikazuje sasvim nov prototip ili nosi drugi naziv na samom listu: zapis 13 i zapis 14 nose nazive sa trećeg časa („kubismo” i „iggyblox”), iako su isti predmeti na četvrtom času zavedeni pod novim nazivima („Tactris” i „čičkolino”); zapis 16 nosi naziv „hobotnica” sa četvrtog časa, a na fotografijama petog časa je nov rad od drvenih štapića sa polovinama nacrtanih oblika (sunce, zvezda, srce, oblak); zapis 17 nosi naziv „Castle” sa trećeg časa, dok na fotografisanom listu piše „Jednostavna zvečka za 3D štampu”; zapis 20 nosi naziv „Music Box” iz prve nedelje, a na ekranu laptopa prikazan je nov 3D model dve šestougaone višeslojne platforme sa kupama i saćem; zapis 24 nosi naziv „praćka” sa četvrtog časa, dok fotografije petog časa prikazuju plavi plišani taktilni jastuk sa vunenim petljama i mrežicom. Molimo autore da potvrde važeće nazive ovih radova za peti čas.
sta.en: Entries 13, 14, 16, 17, 20 and 24: the handwritten fifth-class list carried no work titles, so titles from the same authors’ earlier weeks were carried over during initial processing. Visual inspection shows that several entries depict a brand-new prototype or carry a different title on the photographed sheet itself: entries 13 and 14 carry their third-class titles (“kubismo” and “iggyblox”) even though the same objects were filed under new titles in the fourth class (“Tactris” and “čičkolino”); entry 16 carries the fourth-class title “hobotnica”, whereas the fifth-class photographs show a new work of wooden craft sticks with split drawings (sun, star, heart, cloud); entry 17 carries the third-class title “Castle”, whereas the photographed sheet itself reads “Jednostavna zvečka za 3D štampu” (“Simple rattle for 3D printing”); entry 20 carries the week-1 title “Music Box”, while the laptop screen shows a new 3D model of two hexagonal multi-layered platforms with cones and honeycomb cells; entry 24 carries the fourth-class title “praćka”, while the fifth-class photographs show a blue plush tactile pillow with yarn loops and mesh. Authors are asked to confirm the valid titles for the fifth class.

sta.sr: Zapisi 6, 15 i 28: zapis 6 se vodi kao „Bez naziva”, a na fotografijama je uspravna kartonska kula sa tri kose klackalice na drvenim štapićima i tri obojene posude u dnu — čime se potvrđuje i izgled rada istog autora koji je na trećem času ostao bez fotografije pod uslovnim nazivom „brza putanja”; zapis 15 se vodi kao „Bez naziva”, ali fotografije prikazuju obojenu kutiju za jaja sa kuglicama u boji, koja je na četvrtom času kod istog autora zavedena pod nazivom „boje i oblici”; zapis 28 je sa rukopisnog spiska prepisan kao „чепоflow”, dok na odštampanom plakatu pored samog rada stoji latinični natpis „...enoflow — igračka za razvoj fine motorike, koordinacije i preciznosti” (izbacivanje čepa/žetona pomoću poluge sa gumicom). Molimo autore zapisa 6, 15 i 28 da potvrde tačan naziv.
sta.en: Entries 6, 15 and 28: entry 6 stands as “Untitled”, while its photographs show an upright cardboard drop-tower with three tilting ramps on wooden skewers and three coloured trays at the base — which also confirms the appearance of the same author’s third-class work that had remained unphotographed under the provisional title “brza putanja”; entry 15 stands as “Untitled”, but its photographs show the painted egg carton with coloured balls filed in the fourth class by the same author as “boje i oblici”; entry 28 was transcribed from the handwritten list as “чепоflow”, whereas the printed poster beside the object itself reads “...enoflow — a toy for developing fine motor skills, coordination and precision” (launching a cap/token with an elastic-band lever). The authors of entries 6, 15 and 28 are asked to confirm the exact title.

sta.sr: Zapisi 3, 5, 7, 8, 19, 21, 23 i 29: radovi su fotografisani i objavljeni, ali na spisku petog časa nemaju upisan naziv pa stoje kao „Bez naziva” — zapis 3 (dve spojene drvene ploče sa šarkom i provučenim belim užetom), zapis 5 (kartonski nosač sa tri obojene plastične boce koje vise kao klatna), zapis 7 (osam taktilnih kartica sa reljefnim poljima u kutiji), zapis 8 (drvena osnova sa tiplovima, prstenovima, oprugama i karticama sa zadacima), zapis 19 (kartonska ploča sa šest obojenih reljefnih pločica i prorezima za trake), zapis 21 (mreža drvenih čepova i štapića sa zelenom i žutom trakom), zapis 23 (kutija sa četiri obojena proreza i taktilnim štapićima u boji) i zapis 29 (crna kutija sa kružnim otvorom, polugama i taktilnim valjcima). Autori mogu javiti nazive svojih radova da ih upišemo u registar.
sta.en: Entries 3, 5, 7, 8, 19, 21, 23 and 29: the works are photographed and published, but carry no recorded title on the fifth-class list and stand as “Untitled” — entry 3 (two hinged wooden boards threaded with white rope), entry 5 (cardboard frame with three painted plastic bottles hanging as pendulums), entry 7 (eight tactile cards with relief fields in a box), entry 8 (wooden base with dowels, rings, springs and task cards), entry 19 (cardboard board with six coloured relief tiles and ribbon slots), entry 21 (grid of wooden pegs and sticks with green and yellow ribbons), entry 23 (box with four coloured slots and painted tactile sticks) and entry 29 (black box with a circular opening, levers and tactile cylinders). Authors are welcome to send their work titles so we can enter them in the register.

sta.sr: Potvrđeni su važeći oblici imena zapisa 1 i 3 ovog spiska; isti oblici sada stoje i u spiskovima trećeg i četvrtog časa. Zapis 17 ovog spiska i zapis 30 trećeg časa su isti student: ime je ispravljeno, a indeks dopunjen.
sta.en: The valid name forms of entries 1 and 3 of this list are confirmed; the same forms now stand in the third- and fourth-class lists. Entry 17 of this list and entry 30 of the third class are the same student: the name is corrected and the student number added.

ispravke.izvor: Dopuna studentkinje i potvrda nastavnika predmeta, 02.11.2026.

sta.sr: Autorka rada „uklopko” (zapis 2 četvrtog časa, red 24 na spisku ove posete) bila je na poseti udruženju 30.10.2026. sa unapređenim prototipom, dorađenim po dogovoru sa nastavnikom posle posete četvrtog časa (odštampani listovi sa zadatim rasporedima obojenih kocaka i krovova). Rad nije bio na spisku fotografisanja u učionici, ali je prepoznat i isproban u udruženju na četiri kadra posete (kadrovi 1, 2, 4 i 5 u prilogu posete) i povezan sa dosijeom autorke.
sta.en: The author of the work “uklopko” (entry 2 of the fourth class, row 24 on this visit’s list) attended the association visit of 30 October 2026 with the improved prototype, revised by agreement with the teacher after the fourth-class visit (printed sheets with set arrangements of the coloured cubes and roofs). The work was not on the classroom photography list, but it is recognised and tried at the association across four visit frames (frames 1, 2, 4 and 5 in the visit attachment) and linked to the author’s dossier.
